flashcards.q: How is tailor messages used in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: This chapter teaches you how to divide a market into groups that share real needs, and how to tailor messages, offers and experiences to those groups and to individual buyers, using AI where it helps and data that people would be comfortable knowing you hold.

flashcards.q: What does AI Personalization And Segmentation teach about reachable distinct?
flashcards.a: Build an ideal customer profile and turn it into segments that are measurable, large enough, reachable, distinct and actionable.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with message written in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: A message written for everyone tends to speak to no one in particular, while a message written separately for every person is impossible to produce by hand.

flashcards.q: When is personas applied in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Base personas on interviews, sales call notes and support conversations, and revise them when evidence changes.

flashcards.q: When should generic message not be used in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Personalization without segmentation tends to decorate a generic message with surface details, such as a first name, that do little to make it relevant.

flashcards.q: Where does segment-specific agent come up in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: The chapter closes with a field case from the Sales King Academy platform and a lab in which you build a segment-specific agent with the live Agent Builder.

flashcards.q: Where does your not apply in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Proof: industry no-show patterns from your own customer data.

flashcards.q: Is whether personalization always required in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Design a test that shows whether personalization improves results, including the sample size it needs.

flashcards.q: Is something ever unnecessary in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: The test of personalization is whether it makes a message more useful to the buyer, not whether it shows that you know something about them.

flashcards.q: Which approach to mid-sized businesses fits AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: The most common level for small and mid-sized businesses, and often the best value.

flashcards.q: Which uses of whatever should be ruled out in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Segmentation should start from a clear view of who the business serves best, not from whatever fields happen to be in the database.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with your product in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Done well, both make marketing and sales feel relevant instead of generic, and they direct limited time and money to the buyers most likely to succeed with your product.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling whatever in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Segmentation should start from a clear view of who the business serves best, not from whatever fields happen to be in the database.

flashcards.q: Why does legitimate matter in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: - **Lawful basis and consent.** You need a legitimate reason to use personal data.

flashcards.q: Why is read not always the right choice in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: The example shows why segments should be read from the pattern of scores, not just the total.

flashcards.q: How is whether personalization used in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: You will learn to build segments from an ideal customer profile and from data, size and prioritise them, use clustering and scoring methods, write a message matrix, test whether personalization actually works, and check it for consent and fairness.

flashcards.q: What does AI Personalization And Segmentation teach about buying?
flashcards.a: The characteristics might be the industry a company is in, its size, the role of the person buying, the problem they are trying to solve or the stage they have reached in buying.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with real customers in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: They become harmful when they are invented in a workshop and never checked against real customers.

flashcards.q: When is supplied applied in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: It can point to buyers before they contact you, but it is indirect and often supplied by third parties, so check how it was collected before relying on it.

flashcards.q: When should logins not be used in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: In real data, with thousands of accounts and several features, the analyst would scale the features first; here seats and logins happen to be on similar ranges, so the example works without it.

flashcards.q: Where does divides come up in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: **Segmentation** divides a market or customer base into groups, called segments, whose members share characteristics that matter for how they buy.

flashcards.q: Where does ever not apply in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: A message that reveals such an inference can cause real harm, both to the person and to the business's reputation, even if no sensitive field was ever collected.

flashcards.q: Is accounts always required in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: A software company wants to see whether its accounts fall into natural groups.

flashcards.q: Which approach to dollars fits AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: A business selling contracts worth tens of thousands of dollars can justify researching each account by hand; a business selling a low-priced subscription to thousands of small customers usually does best with a handful of well-designed segments.

flashcards.q: Which uses of seats should be ruled out in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: The second group may contain accounts that bought many seats but never rolled the product out fully, which makes it a candidate for an adoption campaign and a churn risk.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with whether personalization in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: You will learn to build segments from an ideal customer profile and from data, size and prioritise them, use clustering and scoring methods, write a message matrix, test whether personalization actually works, and check it for consent and fairness.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling real customers in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: They become harmful when they are invented in a workshop and never checked against real customers.

flashcards.q: Why does coaching matter in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: It also shows judgment about purpose: information collected for coaching stayed out of marketing.

flashcards.q: How is mass messaging used in AI Personalization And Segmentation?
flashcards.a: Define segmentation and personalization, explain how they differ, and describe the levels of personalization from mass messaging to one-to-one.

flashcards.q: What does AI Personalization And Segmentation teach about segment?
flashcards.a: The point of a segment is that its members respond to similar messages and offers, so the business can treat them as a group.
